title: pseudo-fumaria alba subsp. acaulis
intro: Pseudo-fumaria alba subsp. acaulis, commonly known as White Fumitory, is a plant species belonging to the Papaveraceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of White Fumitory include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Pseudo-fumaria alba subsp. acaulis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
